qualification: Qualified on QEMU virt only, as uefi-x64 is: current signed file deployments with required signed root/support verity, authenticated metadata and component installation; disposable Secure Boot enrollment, full runtime/API, component updates and trial fallback pass. The kernel carries the generic UEFI/ACPI storage set (virtio, NVMe, AHCI, USB) and the common NIC families as modules, but no physical UEFI/ACPI arm64 machine has been booted: physical firmware, hardware-rooted debug policy and those drivers are unqualified. Development signing inputs only; conservative I1 board grade retained pending physical qualification.

evidenceRefs.ref: mica-build:verify/run.sh --verify --board uefi-arm64 --image IMAGE --public-key KEY; current signed file-image checks

physicalBoundaries.jtag: No physical debug interface is modeled by this virtual board.
physicalBoundaries.serialConsole: QEMU console carries boot evidence; product login policy remains unchanged.
physicalBoundaries.recoveryPath: The operator replaces the complete virtual disk image. Disposable AAVMF enrollment is test state.
